body:
Good morning, my friend!

Three little apple trees have come for the meadow beside your house. Would you please help me plant them?

I'll be waiting in the meadow beside your house, past the woodpile.
summary: Plant apple trees with Miss Miriam in the meadow.
done: The apple trees are planted, the beans are watered and the pigs are happy. Well done!
